bootstrap-harness.description: Scan a project, interview about unknowns, and generate a complete AI harness (Claude + Opencode + Copilot).
bootstrap-harness.template:
Load the bootstrap-harness skill and follow its complete workflow.

The skill will direct you to read .agents/skills/bootstrap-harness.md. Run all five phases: probe the project, interview only for unresolved unknowns, render via templates/scripts/bootstrap.sh, validate the output, and report. Render into the output directory below (default: current directory).

$ARGUMENTS

epic-composer.description: Compose an Epic from source material (transcripts, docs, notes).
epic-composer.template:
Load the epic-composer skill and follow its complete workflow on the source material below.

The skill will direct you to read .agents/skills/epic-composer.md for the full instructions. Follow all phases including synthesis, interview (if needed), drafting, and readiness assessment.

$ARGUMENTS

epic-interview.description: Run Epic interview mode to close critical gaps.
epic-interview.template:
Load the epic-interview skill and follow its instructions on the current material and draft.

The skill will direct you to read .agents/skills/epic-interview.md. Do not rewrite the Epic — ask concise, high-value questions grouped by priority, then label the response state.

$ARGUMENTS

epic-acceptance-linter.description: Lint acceptance criteria on an existing Epic draft.
epic-acceptance-linter.template:
Load the epic-acceptance-linter skill and apply it to the acceptance criteria below.

The skill will direct you to read .agents/skills/epic-acceptance-linter.md. Review each criterion for observability, testability, specificity, outcome focus, non-conflict, and coverage. Label the response: PASS, NEEDS_REVISION, or BLOCKED.

$ARGUMENTS

story-decomposer.description: Decompose a ready Epic into INVEST-compliant user stories.
story-decomposer.template:
Load the story-decomposer skill and follow its instructions to decompose the Epic below.

The skill will direct you to read .agents/skills/story-decomposer.md. Verify the Epic is ready, map ACs to stories, write BDD acceptance criteria, apply INVEST, map dependencies, and assess readiness.

$ARGUMENTS

task-decomposer.description: Break down a story into AI-executable engineering tasks.
task-decomposer.template:
Load the task-decomposer skill and apply it to the story below.

The skill will direct you to read .agents/skills/task-decomposer.md. Draft specific tasks with file paths, APIs, and test paths. Lint for specificity and verifiability. Assess AI-parallelization.

$ARGUMENTS

harness-eval.description: Evaluate the installed harness against the project's actual stack.
harness-eval.template:
Read and follow the complete evaluation prompt at docs/harness-eval.md.

That file is the canonical evaluation workflow. Follow all five phases: stack discovery, stack-fit evaluation, trim, suggest missing rules, and report. Present the plan before executing any edits.

$ARGUMENTS
